evals.prompt: Our iOS portfolio chart is unusable with VoiceOver. How do we fix it?
evals.expected_output: A VoiceOver specification for the chart screen with summaries, an accessible data alternative, labels and values, and a test plan on device.
expectations: Proposes a summary plus an accessible representation of the data
Currency values are read via formatted strings
Includes a device VoiceOver test of the critical task
Considers Reduce Motion for chart animations
